summary.en: Occupation codes of the official CBO 2002 table.
summary.pt-BR: Códigos de ocupação da Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações (CBO 2002).

get.summary: Looks a CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) code up in the official CBO 2002 table.
description: Looks a CBO code up in the CBO 2002 occupation table and returns its code and official title.
- Same input rules as `cbo.isValid`; the returned code is the 6 bare digits.
- Returns null for an unknown code or a value not written in one of the accepted forms.

isValid.summary: Validates if a CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) code exists in the official CBO 2002 table.
description: Checks whether a CBO code exists in the official CBO 2002 occupation table.
- Accepts the 6 digits, the `NNNN-NN` mask (a single separator — space, `.`, `-` or `/` — between the groups) or a non-negative integer.
- Bare digits (string or number) are left-padded with zeros to 6; a masked value is read as written.
- Any other string is rejected instead of having its digits picked out.

parse.summary: Removes CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) formatting characters and returns only digits.
description: Removes CBO formatting and keeps only digits, capped to 6 digits.
- Nothing is left-padded: a leading zero has to be written out.

tests.name: caps-length
tests.note: reference truncates to the 6 characters of the document; asserted by the reference (JS) unit tests
